gate_rules.G10_repeated_call_trajectories: >= 200 trajectories re-issue an identical (name, arguments) call - the observable over-search arm T176 and the behavioural-change baseline T190 both need
gate_rules.G11_cluster_count: >= 1,000 trajectories readable at all, so a traj_id-clustered interval exists for every design
gate_rules.G12_category_breadth: >= 5 task categories with >= 100 trajectories each, which is the stratum T175 and T176 report inside
gate_rules.G13_outcome_label_available: the release carries a per-trajectory task outcome (success, reward, pass, exit status) that a premature-versus-over-search mismatch could be scored against. This gate is reported as measured either way, because the sentence it scopes - T176's - can be narrowed to behaviour without moving any threshold, and a fired gate here is a statement about what the release does not record
gate_rules.G1_trajectories_parseable: >= 0.95 of drawn trajectories yield at least one readable assistant turn
gate_rules.G2_task_instruction_present: >= 0.90 of trajectories carry a non-empty task instruction, which is what 'later search' is later than and what an entity count counts against
gate_rules.G3_early_hypothesis_trajectories: >= 200 trajectories state a hypothesis within their first two assistant turns - the arm T171 compares against
gate_rules.G4_trajectories_with_later_turns: >= 500 trajectories have >= 4 assistant turns, so a turn-by-turn concentration profile has a later half
gate_rules.G5_terminal_turn_identifiable: >= 0.95 of trajectories end on an assistant turn, so STOP is a measurable event rather than a guess about a truncated log
gate_rules.G6_observations_parseable: >= 0.80 of trajectories return at least one observation for every call they emitted - marginal information is computed from that content
gate_rules.G7_error_marked_observations: >= 0.05 of observations carry a failure marker, the conditioning event T176's premature arm and T190's correction arm both stand on
gate_rules.G8_verbal_corrections: >= 200 trajectories contain at least one explicit self-correction from the frozen list; below this the construct T190 names is rare in this corpus rather than uninformative
gate_rules.G9_plan_specificity_computable: >= 200 trajectories have a first assistant turn carrying at least two ordering markers and at least two action verbs, the low end of 'a plan whose specificity can be counted'
